name: broderick
status: SEED v0 — extrapolated from source panels 2026-06-11; refine before render
look: Hand-drawn digital comic in grayscale with a single flat brick-red accent reserved for the warning banner. Cleaner and more produced than sibling strips: confident even-weight ink line, flat gray tonal fills in layered planes (gray helicopter, stepped gray skyline silhouettes, gray broadcast set), digital motion-smear on rotor blades. Dialogue sits in white rectangular speech balloons and caption boxes with black borders and tails, set in a consistent bold-italic comic typeface rather than loose hand lettering. Nudity handled as dark silhouette against dim interiors. END badge: white type on an angled black slab.
register: absurdist deadpan comedy register; the joke is in the timing and the flatness of the delivery

ink_black.usage: linework, balloon borders, lettering, END slab, window mullions

copter_gray.usage: helicopter fuselage flat fill, anchor's set shadows

skyline_gray.usage: layered city silhouettes, apartment facade, window-scene midtones

panel_gray.usage: background field gray behind window scene, broadcast graphic blocks

warning_red.usage: title-card warning banner only — the strip's single color accent

paper_white.usage: sky, studio white, balloon interiors, END lettering

casting_canon.anchor: square-jawed broad-shouldered trim man in his 40s, neatly coiffed light hair, light suit, white shirt and tie, permanent toothy broadcast smile, always behind the news desk fiddling with a pen
casting_canon.bruce: unseen adult male voice from the helicopter — pilot; bored contempt curdling into leering hostile sleaze; represented only by balloons entering frame from the aircraft
casting_canon.copilot: unseen adult male voice from the helicopter — crew; snickering enabler; balloons only
casting_canon.window_woman: slim woman in her 20s-30s, long dark curly hair, caught mid-undress pulling a dark top over her head, rendered strictly as a dark back-view silhouette against a dim room, alarmed and indignant

negatives: photorealistic, photograph, 3d render, cgi, cinematic lighting, lens flare, gradient shading, airbrush, watermark, signature, garbled text, malformed lettering, extra fingers, any color other than the flat brick-red banner accent, detailed or photoreal nudity, visible faces inside the helicopter, scratchy sketch line, anime style, cute rounded proportions, balloon-free floating dialogue

continuity.comics: Lock each recurring character with a model sheet (front/side/expression strip) before generating strips; restate the full character description in every panel prompt.
continuity.video: Use the locked panel art as the first frame; restate the full character description in every shot.

legal_rule: Specify every character by age, origin, build, wardrobe, and affect only — never by likeness to a real public figure. If a render resembles a real person, regenerate.

failure_fixes.drifts_photoreal: Add: flat hand-drawn grayscale comic illustration, even ink line, flat gray fills, no photographic rendering, no 3d.
failure_fixes.drifts_explicit: Add: figure as dark featureless silhouette only, no anatomical detail, shadow against dim interior.
failure_fixes.lettering_garbled: Generate art without text; add comic-typeface balloons and captions in post or via dedicated lettering pass.
